# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added a marketplace card for Grok's `SharePoint` connector. No MCP server is bundled; tools are served through the Grok connector bridge once the accounts are linked and the connector is connected on grok.com.
- Logo: Official Microsoft SharePoint product icon from Microsoft's Fluent brand icon CDN, on a padded white tile.
